_doc: Card rarity (design/card-rarity.md): tiers in order; weights per hand slot by source (level, chest, gold_chest); pity_step moves points from common to epic per common / rare slot (level only), reset on epic+; deck budget points per tier (deck_cost) and the cap (deck_budget); fillers fill a slot the deck cannot (no level).
